title: Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on $\Phi$sat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration
abstract: arXiv:2610.11735v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Onboard Artificial Intelligence can improve responsiveness and bandwidth efficiency of Earth Observation systems by processing data directly on the satellite. This paper presents the experience gained from the development, onboard integration, and post-launch adaptation of a lightweight marine anomaly detection pipeline deployed on the European Space Agency's $\Phi$sat-2 mission. The application combines sea segmentation, self-supervised feature encoding of marine regions, generic anomaly detection based on deviations from a normal sea state, and optional characterization of selected anomaly types. Before launch, the pipeline was trained and validated on simulated $\Phi$sat-2 imagery to assess algorithmic performance and compatibility with resource-constrained onboard hardware. translated_title: Φ-sat-2卫星上的海洋异常检测：从基于仿真的开发到在轨演示验证
translated_abstract: 星载人工智能可以通过直接在卫星上处理数据来提高地球观测系统的响应速度和带宽效率。本文介绍了部署在欧洲航天局Φ-sat-2任务上的轻量级海洋异常检测处理流程在开发、星载集成和发射后适配过程中所获得的经验。该应用结合了海洋分割、海洋区域的自监督特征编码、基于与正常海态偏差的通用异常检测，以及对选定异常类型的可选表征。在发射之前，该流程在模拟的Φ-sat-2图像上进行了训练和验证，以评估算法性能以及与资源受限的星载硬件的兼容性。在任务环境中完成集成和功能验证后，早期基于真实Φ-sat-2观测数据的实验揭示出了显著的失配……
tldr: 本文展示了在欧空局Φ-sat-2卫星上部署轻量级海洋异常检测AI流程的完整历程，提出了从仿真数据训练开发到在轨真实数据演示验证的星载AI应用落地路径，并揭示了仿真与真实观测数据之间的失配问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the complete journey of deploying a lightweight marine anomaly detection AI pipeline on ESA's Φ-sat-2 satellite, demonstrating a pathway from simulation-based development to in-orbit validation while revealing significant mismatches between simulated and real acquisitions.
